## Overview

Housing represents one of the most significant forms of wealth in Singapore, and the resale market for Housing and Development Board (HDB) flats plays a vital role in determining household mobility and affordability. The resale price of an HDB flat is influenced by many factors: both structural (e.g., floor area, lease balance, floor level) and locational (e.g., accessibility to public transport, proximity to schools, etc).

Traditional regression models such as Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) have been widely used to explain variations in housing prices. However, housing transactions are inherently spatial, as nearby units often share similar price due to spatial dependence or location effects. As a result, OLS models may lead to biased or inefficient estimates. To overcome this limitation, this exercise employs Geographically Weighted Regression (GWR) to model HDB resale prices in a spatially explicit manner.

## Objective

This study aims to calibrate a spatially explicit explanatory model to uncover the determinants of 4-room HDB resale flat prices in Singapore for the period January to September 2025. Moving beyond global averages, the analysis employs Geographically Weighted Regression (GWR) to investigate how the influence of key factors changes across the urban landscape. Specifically, this research seeks to address three core questions:

- Which structural attributes and locational amenities exert a statistically significant influence on 4-room HDB resale prices?

- In what ways do the magnitudes and significances of these relationships exhibit spatial non-stationarity, varying across Singapore's planning regions?

- To what extent does the geographically weighted modelling framework improve explanatory power and model fit over a traditional, aspatial Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) benchmark?

## Dataset

### The Data

The study integrates both **aspatial** and **geospatial** datasets to model HDB resale prices in Singapore.

| Dataset | Description | Format | Source |
|--------|-------------|--------|--------|
| **HDB Resale Prices** | Resale flat prices based on registration date from Jan 2017 onwards | CSV | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Singapore Master Plan 2019** | URA 2019 Master Plan Planning Subzone boundary data | KML | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Bus Stop Locations** | Land Transport Authority bus stop locations across Singapore | SHP | [LTA DataMall](https://datamall.lta.gov.sg) |
| **MRT/LRT Station Exits** | Locations of all MRT and LRT station exits in Singapore | KML | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Hawker Centres** | Directory of hawker centres managed by National Environment Agency | KML | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Supermarkets** | Locations of supermarkets regulated by Singapore Food Agency | KML | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Park Facilities** | Representative locations of facilities in parks under National Parks Board | GEOJSON | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Eldercare Services** | Directory of eldercare services provided by Ministry of Health | KML | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Childcare Centres** | Locations of licensed childcare centers in Singapore | KML | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Kindergartens** | Locations of registered kindergartens in Singapore | KML | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Primary Schools** | List of all primary schools in Singapore from Ministry of Education | CSV | [MOE](https://www.moe.gov.sg) |
| **Shopping Malls** | Comprehensive list of shopping malls in Singapore with coordinates | CSV | [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_shopping_malls_in_Singapore) |
| **CHAS Clinics** | Locations of Community Health Assist Scheme clinics | KML | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Community Clubs** | Locations of People's Association community clubs | KML | [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg) |
| **Sports Facilities** | ActiveSG sports centers, gyms, swimming pools, and stadiums | CSV | [ActiveSG](https://www.myactivesg.com) |
| **Hospitals** | List of general hospitals in Singapore | CSV | [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_hospitals_in_Singapore) |
| **HDB HIP/MUP Status** | Manual compilation of Home Improvement Programme and Main Upgrading Programme status for HDB blocks | CSV | [HDB Portal](https://www.hdb.gov.sg) |



## Installing and Loading the R packages

The packages that we will use for this study are outlined below:

| Package | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| [**sf**](https://r-spatial.github.io/sf/) | Provides functions to manage, process, and manipulate **Simple Features**, a formal geospatial data standard for storing and accessing spatial geometries like points, lines, and polygons. |
| [**tidyverse**](https://www.tidyverse.org/) | A collection of packages for data science tasks such as importing, tidying, wrangling, and visualizing data. |
| [**tmap**](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/tmap/) | Enables cartographic-quality static maps and interactive maps using the [leaflet](https://leafletjs.com/) API. |
| [**GWmodel**](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GWmodel/index.html) | Provides tools for calibrating geographically weighted models, including Geographically Weighted Regression (GWR). |
| [**olsrr**](https://olsrr.rsquaredacademy.com/) | Facilitates building OLS regression models and performing diagnostic tests. |
| [**ggplot2**](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/) | A powerful graphics system for creating elegant plots based on the Grammar of Graphics. |
| [**spdep**](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/spdep/index.html) | Offers functions to create spatial weights matrices from polygon contiguities and test for spatial autocorrelation. |
| [**gtsummary**](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/index.html) | Creates publication-ready summary tables for regression models with elegant and flexible formatting. |
| [**sfdep**](https://sfdep.r-spatial.org/) | Builds on `spdep` with a tidyverse-friendly interface, list-columns, and enhanced spatial dependence analysis tools. |
| [**httr**](https://httr.r-lib.org/) | Provides tools for working with HTTP requests, useful for accessing web APIs like OneMap SG for geocoding. |
| [**jsonlite**](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/jsonlite/index.html) | A fast and flexible JSON parser and generator optimized for statistical and web data. |
| [**corrplot**](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/corrplot/index.html) | Enables visual exploration of correlation matrices using various plotting methods. |
| [**performance**](https://easystats.github.io/performance/) | Offers comprehensive tools for assessing regression model performance, including R², RMSE, and diagnostics. |



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, sf, tmap, GWmodel, olsrr, ggplot2, spdep, gtsummary, 
               sfdep, httr, jsonlite, corrplot, performance)
```
:::
